description: You are logged into Emoncms at http://localhost as the admin user (username: admin, password: admin). There is an input named 'heatpump' under the 'home' node that currently has no input processes configured. Navigate to the Inputs page, find the 'heatpump' input, and add a 'Log to Feed' process that logs data to a new feed named 'Heat Pump Log'. Save the process list for that input.
